title: spar-exocortex per-case execution result envelope
description: Single execution result emitted by the harness for one (candidate, case) pair. Step 4 produces an array of these spanning baseline × cases + challenger × cases.

case.description: Case identifier. Convention: 'standard:<n>' for shared-test-set cases, 'attacker' for the attacker's failingInput, 'edge:<name>' for subagent-named edges.

outcome.description: pass = expected output; fail = wrong output; timeout = exceeded --execution-timeout-ms; error = runtime exception in candidate code.

wallClockMs.description: Optional. Wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Required for complexity-stress cases; optional otherwise.

expected.description: Optional. Expected output (for pass/fail outcomes). Useful for judge readability.

actual.description: Optional. Actual output produced by the candidate.

errorMessage.description: Required when outcome=error or outcome=timeout. Captures the exception message or timeout reason.
